projects.name: Replenishment Planning
projects.description: Inventory replenishment and stock optimization system

projects.name: Raw Material Planning
projects.description: Raw material procurement and demand forecasting

issues.title: Reorder point recommendations are outdated
issues.description: The ROP calculations seem to be using stale lead time data. Our suppliers updated lead times 2 weeks ago but the system is still using old values, causing overstock situations.

issues.title: API timeout when querying >10000 inventory records
issues.description: When we try to export historical inventory data for analytics, the API times out after 30 seconds. We have 18,000 SKU records.

issues.title: Add supplier performance metrics dashboard
issues.description: Would like to see on-time delivery %, defect rates, and lead time consistency for each supplier in a dashboard view.

issues.title: Need bulk upload feature for demand forecasts
issues.description: Currently we manually enter demand forecasts for 500+ SKUs one by one. A CSV bulk upload feature would save us 4-5 hours per month.

issues.title: Forecast accuracy metrics not loading
issues.description: The dashboard shows a blank MAPE chart for the past 3 days. Error message briefly appears then disappears. Affects our weekly review process.

issues.title: Safety stock calculation not reflecting seasonal peaks
issues.description: When we input seasonal demand patterns, the safety stock calculator is not adjusting the output accordingly. Expected a 25% increase for Q4 peak season but the system calculated only 8%.

issues.title: Stock depletion alert not triggering for SKU-001
issues.description: The replenishment system is not sending alerts when stock falls below the safety threshold. This is causing stockouts.

issues.title: Slow performance when generating replenishment reports
issues.description: The replenishment forecast report is taking 45+ minutes to generate. This blocks planning decisions.

issues.title: Export replenishment data to CSV failing
issues.description: Users cannot export replenishment recommendations to CSV format. JSON export works but CSV throws error.

issues.title: Need dashboard visualization for replenishment trends
issues.description: Add a dashboard showing 90-day replenishment trend analysis with visual charts and SKU velocity analysis.

issues.title: Production batch calculation gives incorrect quantities
issues.description: Batch calculation algorithm produces wrong quantities for multi-component products. Rounding errors causing material shortages.

issues.title: Machine downtime tracking incomplete
issues.description: System is not capturing all machine downtime events. Some maintenance windows are being skipped.

issues.title: Supplier lead time not updating in forecasts
issues.description: Raw material forecasts using outdated supplier lead times. Supplier A's lead time changed from 14 to 21 days.

issues.title: Access denied error for raw material reports
issues.description: Some CLIENT_USER users cannot access raw material planning reports even though they should have read access.

issues.title: Seasonal demand prediction accuracy is low
issues.description: ML model for seasonal demand is only 62% accurate. Forecasts are off by 30-40% during peak seasons.

issues.title: Add color and size variant tracking to replenishment
issues.description: Need granular tracking for color, size, and material type variants for fashion items.

issues.title: Production schedule conflicts with resource constraints
issues.description: Planner schedules 3 concurrent jobs on equipment that can only handle 1. System should check resource availability.

issues.title: Quality control checkpoints missing from production workflow
issues.description: Add mandatory QC checkpoints after cutting, stitching, and finishing stages with pass/fail gates.

issues.title: Plans Generation Issue
issues.description: Plans Generation is failing
issues.aiSummary: Plans generation failure is blocking core platform functionality and affects all users across planning modules. · Module: General

issues.title: Production schedule export missing setup times
issues.description: When we export the daily production schedule to PDF, setup times between batches are omitted, confusing operators on the floor.

issues.title: Capacity planning shows incorrect available capacity
issues.description: Dashboard reports 40% available capacity but when we tried to schedule new order we hit bottleneck. Calculation seems to ignore constraint machines.

issues.title: Integration with third-party logistics platform fails intermittently
issues.description: Our 3PL provider's API returns 500 errors every few hours. When this happens, we can't pull real-time inventory from their warehouses. Started happening after their system upgrade last week.

issues.title: Add comparison view for different forecast scenarios
issues.description: Want to compare 'optimistic', 'realistic', and 'pessimistic' demand scenarios side-by-side before finalizing forecast.

issues.title: Master schedule conflicts not highlighted
issues.description: System allows scheduling two production runs on the same line for overlapping times. We caught this manually but system should prevent it.

issues.title: ROP recommendation engine keeps timing out
issues.description: Every Friday afternoon when we run weekly ROP recommendations, the job times out. Recovered SKUs: 2400/3200 before failure.

issues.title: Safety stock threshold alert not triggering
issues.description: We set up low-stock alerts but only received 2 out of 15 expected alerts this month. Toothpaste SKU almost went out of stock without notification.

issues.title: Export ROP recommendations as PDF report
issues.description: Currently we can only view ROP calculations on screen. Need ability to export as PDF with timestamp and recommendations for auditing purposes.

issues.title: Demand forecast shows no data for new SKUs
issues.description: When we add new toothpaste variant SKU, forecast algorithm returns 0 predicted demand instead of interpolating from similar SKUs.

issues.title: Cross-training recommendations missing from dashboard
issues.description: System tracks operator skills but doesn't suggest cross-training opportunities when bottlenecks detected. Manual analysis required.

issues.title: Add preventive maintenance scheduling
issues.description: Need to schedule preventive maintenance windows that block production capacity. Currently done manually in separate system.

issues.title: Seasonal adjustment factor input is unclear
issues.description: The UI for entering seasonal adjustment factors (1.0-2.0) is not intuitive. Received 5 support calls about proper usage this week.

issues.title: Inventory count discrepancies not flagged
issues.description: When physical inventory differs from system by >5%, system should highlight as anomaly. Currently shows no warning.

issues.title: Supplier lead time exceptions not being tracked
issues.description: When a supplier delivers late, we manually log it but system doesn't update the statistical lead time. Manual workaround needed.

issues.title: Service level targets not editable per category
issues.description: Need different service level targets for premium vs budget product lines but system enforces one global target.

issues.title: Lead time variability calculation seems wrong
issues.description: Standard deviation calculation for lead times doesn't match our manual calculations. Off by ~15% consistently.

issues.title: Demand forecast shows negative values for some products
issues.description: After running the forecast algorithm yesterday, three products are showing -450, -200, and -80 units. This is clearly a calculation error.

issues.title: Batch size optimizer sometimes recommends uneconomical runs
issues.description: For small orders, the system sometimes recommends batch sizes that result in 30% idle machine time. Algorithm needs refinement.

issues.title: Currency fluctuation impact not calculated
issues.description: For imported raw materials, need to see how exchange rate changes affect total landed cost but system shows only base supplier price.

issues.title: Supplier financial health monitoring missing
issues.description: One major supplier was going into bankruptcy which we didn't know until their delivery stopped. Need to monitor supplier financial indicators.

issues.title: Supplier performance tracking incomplete
issues.description: On-time delivery metric only counts if delivery is within supplier's quoted lead time, not our required lead time. Showing false positives.

issues.title: Material quality inspection reports not linked to POs
issues.description: Inspection reports and test results stored separately. System doesn't link quality data back to the PO for traceability.

issues.title: Supplier diversity reporting incomplete
issues.description: Cannot filter or report on orders from minority-owned or women-owned suppliers. Need compliance reporting capability.

issues.title: Material consumption forecasting showing -20% error
issues.description: Forecast for fluoride compound consumption is consistently 20% lower than actual. Model may need retraining on recent data.

issues.title: Production efficiency metrics not calculating correctly
issues.description: OEE calculation shows 92% but manual audit shows 78%. System may be excluding downtime from the baseline.

issues.title: Buffer time calculation doesn't account for line type
issues.description: System adds 15% buffer for all lines but our high-speed packaging line needs only 8% while complex mixing needs 25%.

issues.title: Material shortage alerts sent too late
issues.description: Alert for critical raw material shortage arrived 2 days after inventory dropped below minimum. Need real-time monitoring.

issues.title: Expedited shipping cost optimization missing
issues.description: When emergency material is needed, system doesn't compare expedited shipping options (air, express, etc) or consolidation with other POs.

issues.title: Customs clearance delays not factored into lead time
issues.description: Imported ingredients often experience 2-5 day customs delays but system uses supplier's promised lead time, not actual door-to-door time.

issues.title: Material shelf-life not tracked
issues.description: Some raw materials have 12-month shelf life but system doesn't warn when receiving old stock or about-to-expire inventory.

issues.title: Add WIP limit alerts by production line
issues.description: Want alerts when work-in-progress inventory exceeds targets for each line. Currently no visibility into WIP accumulation.

issues.title: Schedule optimization takes >5 minutes for 100 orders
issues.description: When running the optimization algorithm to minimize changeovers for 100 pending orders, it times out. Need faster algorithm.

issues.title: Gantt chart rendering performance degraded
issues.description: When viewing 30-day schedule with 500+ production runs, the Gantt chart takes 15+ seconds to load and becomes unresponsive.

issues.title: Add constraint-based scheduling rules
issues.description: Want to specify rules like 'only run Product A on Line 2' or 'never schedule back-to-back batches >6 hours'. Currently no way to enforce.

issues.title: Schedule changes not syncing with ERP system
issues.description: When we update production schedule in this system, ERP material requirements don't update. Causing material shortages on floor.

issues.title: Add supplier alternative recommendation engine
issues.description: When primary supplier has quality issues, system should automatically suggest vetted alternative suppliers with price/quality comparison.

issues.title: Landed cost calculation missing import duties and taxes
issues.description: True cost of imported materials is 15-20% higher than what system shows. Excluding duties, tariffs, and freight from cost calculation.

comments.content: Fixed: Changed alert threshold check from 'less than' to 'less than or equal to'. Alerts now trigger correctly at threshold levels.
Fixed rounding error in BatchCalculator. Changed Math.floor() to Math.round() with proper decimal precision. Tested - now accurate.
Updated Supplier A lead time from 14 to 21 days in database. Regenerated forecasts. Forecast now correct for 21-day lead time.
Improved ML model with fashion-specific features and 5-year training data. Accuracy improved from 62% to 87% during peak seasons.

knowledgeBase.title: How to Set Up Safety Stock Levels
knowledgeBase.content:
Safety stock is inventory held to protect against demand variability and supply uncertainty.

## Why Safety Stock Matters
- Prevents stockouts during demand spikes
- Absorbs supply delays
- Maintains service levels to customers

## Steps to Configure:
1. Analyze historical demand patterns (last 24 months)
2. Calculate service level required (95% = 1.65σ, 99% = 2.33σ)
3. Multiply by standard deviation of demand
4. Set minimum stock to safety stock level

## Best Practices:
- Review safety stock quarterly
- Adjust for seasonal patterns
- Monitor actual stockout incidents
- Balance carrying costs with service level

knowledgeBase.title: Optimizing Reorder Points (ROP)
knowledgeBase.content:
Reorder Point (ROP) is the inventory level at which a new purchase order is triggered.

## Formula:
ROP = (Average Daily Demand × Lead Time in Days) + Safety Stock

## Example:
- Daily demand: 50 units
- Lead time: 10 days
- Safety stock: 150 units
- ROP = (50 × 10) + 150 = 650 units

## Implementation Tips:
1. Account for supply chain variability
2. Adjust for seasonal demand changes
3. Monitor actual vs. projected lead times
4. Review ROP monthly

## Common Mistakes to Avoid:
- Setting ROP too low (causes stockouts)
- Not adjusting for seasonality
- Ignoring supply chain disruptions
- Manual calculation errors

knowledgeBase.title: Troubleshooting: Demand Forecast Accuracy
knowledgeBase.content:
If your demand forecasts are consistently off, follow this diagnostic guide.

## Check These First:
1. Data Quality - Are historical sales accurate?
2. Seasonality - Did you account for patterns?
3. Outliers - Remove anomalies
4. Lead Time - Is horizon aligned?

## Common Causes:
- Missing seasonal adjustments: 15-20% error
- Promotional periods not labeled: 25% error
- Inaccurate historical data: 30% error
- Ignoring trend changes: 40% error

## Solutions:
- Use exponential smoothing for trend
- Segment by product category
- Include external factors
- Validate with domain experts

## Validation:
- Check MAPE (Mean Absolute Percentage Error)
- Target: < 15% for mature products
- Target: < 25% for new products

knowledgeBase.title: Setting Up Production Schedules Effectively
knowledgeBase.content:
Master scheduling ensures resources are used efficiently and orders are met on time.

## Key Principles:
1. Capacity Planning - Never exceed capacity by >85%
2. Batch Sizing - Balance setup costs vs. inventory
3. Lead Time - Account for setup and run time
4. Buffer Time - Add 10-15% for downtime

## Scheduling Steps:
1. Confirm available capacity
2. Schedule high-priority first
3. Group similar products
4. Validate against constraints
5. Monitor execution

## Avoiding Bottlenecks:
- Identify constraint machines
- Schedule constraint first
- Work backward from due date
- Cross-train operators
- Maintain preventive schedule

knowledgeBase.title: Quality Control Checkpoints in Manufacturing
knowledgeBase.content:
Implementing effective QC checkpoints reduces defect rates and rework costs.

## Standard QC Gates:
1. Raw Material Inspection - Check supplier documentation
2. In-Process QC - After critical operations
3. Final Inspection - Before packaging
4. Statistical Sampling - Per ISO 2859

## Defect Documentation:
- Log all defects with root cause
- Photo evidence for traceability
- Update QC database immediately
- Alert if > 2% defect rate

## Corrective Actions:
- Minor defects: Rework
- Major defects: Production halt
- Critical defects: Quarantine

## Metrics to Track:
- First Pass Yield (FPY)
- Defect Rate (%)
- Average Rework Cost
- Customer Returns

knowledgeBase.title: Supplier Lead Time Management
knowledgeBase.content:
Accurate lead time data is critical for inventory and production planning.

## Tracking Lead Times:
1. Record PO date and delivery date
2. Calculate average (exclude outliers)
3. Track variability (std dev)
4. Monitor seasonal changes

## Lead Time Components:
- Procurement: 2-5 days
- Manufacturing: varies
- Transit: 5-20 days
- Customs/clearance: 1-3 days

## Managing Variability:
- Build safety stock for high-variability
- Diversify suppliers
- Negotiate fixed lead times
- Use freight forwarders

## Red Flags:
- Lead time increases > 20%
- Missed deliveries
- Quality issues
- Communication delays

knowledgeBase.title: Material Shortage Resolution Process
knowledgeBase.content:
Step-by-step guide to handle raw material shortages without halting production.

## Immediate Actions (Day 1):
1. Verify actual shortage vs. system error
2. Check alternate suppliers
3. Assess production impact
4. Notify stakeholders
5. Explore emergency procurement

## Short-term Solutions (Days 1-5):
- Expedited shipping from suppliers
- Emergency purchases (accept premium)
- Substitute materials (with approval)
- Reduce production pace

## Medium-term Solutions (Days 5-30):
- Source from backup suppliers
- Negotiate temporary price increases
- Implement rationing
- Accelerate shipments

## Prevention:
- Maintain 30-day safety stock
- Dual-source critical materials
- Monitor supplier health
- Weekly shortage reviews

knowledgeBase.title: System Best Practices: Data Entry & Accuracy
knowledgeBase.content:
Maintaining data accuracy ensures reliable planning and forecasting.

## Daily Checklist:
- Enter sales transactions within 24 hours
- Update inventory counts after counts
- Record supplier lead time changes
- Log machine downtime with reason
- Update demand forecasts weekly

## Common Data Errors:
1. Transposed quantities
2. Wrong product codes
3. Incorrect UOM
4. Stale forecast data
5. Unrecorded returns

## Validation Rules:
- Quantity must be > 0
- Product code must exist
- Date cannot be future
- Supplier lead time: 5-45 days
- Forecast variance < 50%

## Reporting Issues:
- Screenshot error
- Note steps to reproduce
- Report to administrator
- Check backup availability
